delay.description: Delay in seconds from starting a new test configuration before starting the sampling.

samples.description: Number of samples (test rounds) for the CPU test.

cpus.description: List of CPU numbers to run tests on. Empty means auto-detect all CPUs.

run_duration.description: Duration of each test run in seconds.

calibrate_per_cpu.description: Calibrate for each CPU run individually instead of averaging all CPUs.

rapl_read.description: Read power statistics from RAPL domains.

output_file.description: Path to the YAML file for output results.
